declarations.description:
Collapsible disclosure built on native `<details>` / `<summary>`, so keyboard access, screen-reader semantics and
find-in-page auto-expand come from the browser. Panels that share a `name` form an exclusive accordion. Open and
close animate the content height (plus a fade) with the Web Animations API, so the motion is identical in every
browser; the native `open` attribute is only removed once the close animation has finished.

slots.description: Second header row under the title (description, badges, actions). Stays visible when collapsed; clicks inside it do not toggle the panel, so buttons and links work there.

slots.description: Alternative icon shown only while open (replaces the rotation).
slots.name: expanded-icon

members.name: expanded
members.description: Open state, kept in sync with the native `open` attribute.

members.name: label
members.description: Header text when the `title` slot is empty.

members.name: name
members.description:
Accordion group: opening a panel closes every other `c2-details` with the same name in the same document or shadow
root. (The native `name` attribute cannot be used: each panel's `<details>` sits in its own shadow tree.)

members.name: titleNotClickable
members.description: Only the icon toggles the panel; clicking the title does nothing.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Dims the header and blocks toggling (pointer and keyboard).

members.name: closing
members.description: Keeps the native `open` attribute while the close animation plays; the content is hidden by the browser otherwise.

members.name: animateContent
members.description:
Slides the content between collapsed and its natural height, fading the body along the way. Duration and easing
come from the `transition-*` values the stylesheet puts on the content element, so `--c2-details--transition-duration`
and `prefers-reduced-motion` both apply. Reversing mid-flight starts from the current rendered height.

events.description: Re-dispatched from the native details after it opens or closes (`newState` is `open` or `closed`).
